text: 金十数据7月27日讯，商务部新闻发言人表示，中方敦促美方倾听中美两国业界客观、理性声音，纠正霸权思维，停止对中国企业的抹黑和制裁威胁。对于任何实质性损害中方利益的行为，中方将采取一切必要措施，坚定维护自身正当合法权益。希望美方切实落实两国元首共识，同中方相向而行，加强人工智能对话、沟通，共同推动人工智能向上向善，通过推进并完善人工智能治理造福两国和世界。
text_en: Jin10 data July 27 - Ministry of Commerce spokesperson stated China urges the U.S. to listen to the objective and rational voices of industries from both countries, correct hegemonic thinking, and stop smearing and threatening sanctions against Chinese companies. For any actions that substantially damage China's interests, China will take all necessary measures to firmly safeguard its legitimate rights and interests. China hopes the U.S. will effectively implement the consensus of the two heads of state, work with China in the same direction, strengthen AI dialogue and communication, jointly promote AI for good, and advance and improve AI governance for the benefit of both nations and the world.
